Callout.Name: Smoke in a Block of Flats
Callout.Message: Smoke in a communal stairwell of a block.

Script.Line: The smoke is in the stairwell and it is going up.
Nobody has come past me and I have been here ten minutes.
The door of number six is warm. I am not touching it.

Lines.Approach: The stairwell is full of smoke and nobody knows which flat it is coming from.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
